title: Create a reproducible failing task
explanation: Three cases fail: a missing user crashes, an inactive administrator is allowed, and an active viewer is allowed. Only an active administrator should pass. The test file remains unchanged.

title: Configure the scenario and limits
explanation: Inputs are validated before starting the runtime. The limit preset forces maxTurns to 1. Effort and partial-message settings are actual SDK options, not a simulated dashboard.

title: Set availability, approval and settings
explanation: The repair scenario enables Read/Edit/Glob/Bash, with only exactly npm test allowed by the host guard. Read-only inspection removes editing and Bash. Project settings are opt-in and the fixture includes a classroom CLAUDE.md.

title: Group assistant response IDs
explanation: Every observed message increments its type count. Assistant message.message.id groups blocks from the same response. This grouped count is labelled separately from the final SDK num_turns.

title: Match tool results to their requests
explanation: A tool request records its block ID and response group. A later user tool_result carries tool_use_id, so feedback can be linked without assuming every user message is a human prompt.

title: Preserve result metadata on every subtype
explanation: Only success with is_error false is success. Other subtypes keep their identity while cost, usage, turn count, stop reason and session ID remain available. Stream events update counts without inventing more turns.

title: Iterate to completion, then check the file
explanation: The host does not break at the result. If the runtime throws after yielding a result, the observed subtype is preserved. A failure before any result remains an error. Independent host checks examine the actual resulting auth.ts.
